notes: v495 — the last of the audit: speed and a rounding fault. Pressing 🏆 Top 20 used to freeze for about four seconds while the app quietly prepared a year of grading before showing you anything; the twenty shares now appear straight away and the grading catches up a moment later. Big tables draw about a fifth faster. And several "within 3%" style tests were being made against the rounded number rather than the real one — a share 3.4% below its 52-week high read as "within 3%", and a 2.5% gap flagged as a 3% gap. The tests now use the exact figure; the number on screen is unchanged. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
